_readme: Where each signatory logo comes from. Run `npm run logos:fetch` in tools/, then `node logos.mjs`. `url`: official file, preferably SVG, from the organisation's own site or Wikimedia Commons. `supplied`: a file in assets/new logos/ (a local inbox, not committed; the trimmed copy in assets/source/logos/ is what we keep), used when no web version matches the design we were sent; whitespace is trimmed. Only take a web file when it is the same design as the supplied one.
